question: Who among the following become Member of Parliament from Rampur, Uttar Pradesh in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ghanshyam Singh Lodhi.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Ghanshyam Singh Lodhi:-**

 
 
• Ghanshyam Singh Lodhi is an Indian politician who has **served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for the Rampur constituency in Uttar Pradesh since 2022.**
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• In 2022, Lodhi was the BJP candidate for the Rampur Lok Sabha by-election. He defeated the Samajwadi Party candidate, Azam Khan's wife, by a margin of over 42,000 votes. Lodhi's victory was seen as a major upset, as Rampur has been a stronghold of the Samajwadi Party for decades.
 
• As an MP, Lodhi has focused on issues such as development, education, and healthcare. He has also been a vocal supporter of the BJP government's policies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Yogi Adityanath:-**

 
 
• **He is the 22nd and current Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, the most populous state in India. **
 
• Adityanath is a Hindu monk and the head priest of the Gorakhnath Math. 
 
 
 
• **Dinesh Lal Yadav:-**
 
 
• He is known by his stage name Nirahu.
 
• **He is an Indian actor, singer, and politician who works in the Bhojpuri film industry.**
 
• He is one of the most popular and successful Bhojpuri actors, and has starred in over 100 films.
 
 
 
• **Akhilesh Yadav:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian politician who is currently the Leader of the Opposition in the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly. **
 
• He is also the president of the Samajwadi Party (SP), a regional political party in Uttar Pradesh.
